summary.text: Marlon Anderson is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 76, an office he has held since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and St. Louis native, he earned his law degree from Southern University Law Center in 2011.

paragraphs.text: Marlon Anderson was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and graduated from Gateway Institute of Technology in 2000.
He earned an associate degree from St. Louis Community College, a bachelor's degree in mass media from Clark Atlanta University, and a J.D. from Southern University Law Center in 2011.

Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working with the Louisiana Public Defender Juvenile Litigations Division, the St. Louis City Circuit Attorney's Office, and the Law Office of Marlon S. Anderson, and that he has served with the Northside Neighborhood Action Association.
Anderson assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Chris Carter, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are as vice chair of the Ethics Committee and as a member of the Joint Committee on the Justice System.
